review_note: Reviewed 2026-10-25. CHSH2 + S: the three atomic-sulfur 3p directions (four electrons) plus the fragment radical. Source canonical 18,20,21,22; selected near natural 19-22. Three doublets and three quartets represent the sulfur spatial manifold, with equal total spin-block weights. Selected from native occupations and AO coefficients, not an energy-window rule. These fixed-geometry CASSCF screens select a production model; they do not establish quantitative CASPT2-F12, angular or asymptotic-plateau convergence. Preserve production orbital, root and connectivity checks. State averaging is optimization support; only D1 contributes reactive flux. Direct CASPT2-F12 uses avdz-f12/avtz-f12 CBS power 3.7 and the separate 30 angstrom asymptote.
